scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const file of ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock']) fs.rmSync(file,{force:true}); if (!process.env.npm_config_user_agent?.startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev" "pnpm --filter @workspace/acquire-360-ventures run dev"
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm run db:push && pnpm run seed
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
